newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY

- High-profile meeting on industrial safety opens to call on nation to attach great importance to issue, President Jiang sends message to meeting, urging discipline and management be tightened up to ensure safety in work place.
- Chinese Premier Li Peng highly commends role played by Organisation of African Unity in talks in Cameroon
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- President Jiang Zemin sends letter of consolation to Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani over earthquake
- Propaganda ministry holds meeting of provincial television stations calling for television programmes to boost national stability and unity
CHINA SECURITIES
- Vice minister of State Commission for Economic Restructuring calls for continuing share-holding reforms and implementation of company law
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Chairman of U.S. Federal Reserve Alan Greenspan to visit from May 14-16
ECONOMIC DAILY
- State Councillor chen Junsheng calls for speeding up animal husbandry by comprehensively developing resources
HAINAN DAILY
- Tornado in Hainan Wuchang port kils 11 and causes 7.2 million yuan in losses
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DAILY
- New type of soybean produced in Heilongjiang province
CHINA DAILY
- More than 5,000 local workers and forest rangers put out a forest fire that broke out in Inner Mongolia region on May 2.

- Public opinions on Consultation Document on Civil Liberties and Social Order were heard and respected, a spokesman for the Chief Executive's Office of the Hong Kong Special Administration Region said in Shenzhen
